Class 3's own rule: a quantity that must equal a value is fixed as an input, not searched for and then constrained. bioshield.outer_radius is already the literal 8.55 [m], so the gate asserted a literal against itself.
Composition closure (class 4) over two terms; the last term is derived. gamma_shield.fraction_volume := 1.0 - neutron_shield.fraction_volume.
Structural identity (class 1). outer_radius := inner_radius + wall_thickness; the source comment already recorded that the literal came from that sum.
The only derivable row in Group C. p_neutron := p_fusion - p_alpha; the band checked arithmetic the generator already guarantees. Pairs with A1, the same identity re-asserted at instance level.

Body is the literal `true` — a vacuous always-pass gate waiting for Item 6's capability. The derivative is the worked example of the policy and does not carry it; the frozen twins keep it for history.
Body is the literal `true`. Same ruling as C21.

Layer continuity (class 1) over the whole radial build. gate_feasible_candidate._note: A MACHINERY EXEMPLAR, NOT A RECOMMENDED DESIGN. It exists to show the satisfied path executes; no one is proposing a 20 GW fusion plant. A2 alone turns satisfied at p_fusion >= 16000; all three gates satisfy at 20000. A9 is satisfied at the authored design point and on both legs: pumping_speed_total = 200 against n_pumps * pump_capacity_each = 48 * 4.17 = 200.16, a 0.08% disagreement inside the ruled 1% band, and the p_fusion mutation touches no pumping attribute.
gate_feasible_candidate.headline: full_satisfaction

gate_infeasible_candidate._note: This is the model's OWN authored design point, and it is the rejected candidate. MagnetCryogenicLoad.cooling_power = 8396.054399837172 MW against p_electric_gross = 1546.723690193402 MW (5.43x), so p_electric_net_out is negative before any mutation. Cause: heat_leak = magnet_volume * 0.05 // MW (library/analyses/thermal_loads.sysml:59) contributes 116.72 MW of the 167.92 MW cryogenic load, amplified 300/(20*0.3) = 50x. Filed as backlog [CATF-CRYO-HEAT-LEAK-COEFFICIENT]; reproduces on the untouched catf_mfe_d5.
